Hand-written credential responses, in the shape the services really answer with, and with
fixed expiries so that what a test asserts does not depend on the clock.

  pc-sas-fresh.json    a Planetary Computer SAS token that expires in 2999, so a second
                       `rewrite` is answered from the cache
  pc-sas-expired.json  the same body with a 2020 expiry, so a second `rewrite` re-requests

The shape itself is not invented: ../endpoints/planetary-computer-sas/token.json is what the
service sent on 2026-09-02, and test/auth.jl parses that recording as well. These two carry
no signature that ever signed anything.
